Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /app/test/01-factorial.scm:
     1	;; Test 1: Factorial - Classic recursive function
     2	
     3	(define (factorial n)
     4	  (if (= n 0)
     5	      1
     6	      (* n (factorial (- n 1)))))
     7	
     8	;; Test factorial of 5
     9	(display (factorial 5))
    10	(newline)
    11	
    12	;; Test factorial of 10
    13	(display (factorial 10))
    14	(newline)
    15	
    16	;; Tail-recursive version
    17	(define (factorial-tail n)
    18	  (define (fact-iter n acc)
    19	    (if (= n 0)
    20	        acc
    21	        (fact-iter (- n 1) (* n acc))))
    22	  (fact-iter n 1))
    23	
    24	;; Test factorial of 20 (tail-recursive)
    25	(display (factorial-tail 20))
    26	(newline)
